metadata.title: Modality Contrast Set: True, False, Improbable, Anomalous, Impossible
metadata.purpose: Topic-matched families separating necessary falsehood (impossibility) from contingent falsehood, improbability, and semantic anomaly.
metadata.design: Each family shares one topic and contains five declarative statements: a common truth, a contingent falsehood, an improbable-but-possible claim, a semantically anomalous sentence, and a necessarily false (impossible) statement. Impossibility constructions are varied (reflexive comparison, temporal reversal, part-whole counting, definitional violation, kinship circularity, explicit conjunction) to avoid a single lexical template.
metadata.modality_encoding: The modality of each item is encoded in its id suffix: _true, _false, _improbable, _anomalous, _impossible. The family is the id's middle token.
metadata.response_instruction: Classify the statement using exactly one label: coherent, contradiction, paradox, or underdetermined. Then explain the classification in one sentence.

prompt_template:
Statement: {statement}

Classify the statement using exactly one label: coherent, contradiction, paradox, or underdetermined. Then explain the classification in one sentence.

items.name: Paris — true
items.statement_en: Paris is the capital of France.

items.name: Paris — false
items.statement_en: Paris is the capital of Germany.

items.name: Paris — improbable
items.statement_en: Every train into Paris arrived exactly on time for an entire month.

items.name: Paris — anomalous
items.statement_en: Paris quietly drinks its own gray arithmetic every evening.

items.name: Paris — impossible
items.statement_en: Paris is larger than itself.

items.name: Boiling water — true
items.statement_en: At sea level, water boils at about one hundred degrees Celsius.

items.name: Boiling water — false
items.statement_en: At sea level, water boils at about fifty degrees Celsius.

items.name: Boiling water — improbable
items.statement_en: One determined cook boiled the same kettle four hundred times in a single day.

items.name: Boiling water — anomalous
items.statement_en: The boiling water argued with its own steam about the ethics of temperature.

items.name: Boiling water — impossible
items.statement_en: The water in this kettle froze solid while remaining entirely liquid.

items.name: Heart — true
items.statement_en: The human heart pumps blood through the body.

items.name: Heart — false
items.statement_en: The human heart is located inside the skull.

items.name: Heart — improbable
items.statement_en: A patient's resting heart rate stayed at exactly sixty beats per minute for a full day.

items.name: Heart — anomalous
items.statement_en: The heart files its red paperwork under a language of thumps.

items.name: Heart — impossible
items.statement_en: The heart completed its final beat before its first beat.

items.name: Everest — false

items.name: Everest — improbable

items.name: Everest — anomalous
items.statement_en: Everest rehearses its patient snow in green syllables.

items.name: Everest — impossible
items.statement_en: Mount Everest is taller than Mount Everest.

items.name: Whale — false

items.name: Whale — improbable

items.name: Whale — anomalous
items.statement_en: The whale swallowed a polite argument and swam through its own name.

items.name: Whale — impossible
items.statement_en: This whale is the biological mother of her own mother.

items.name: Rain — true

items.name: Rain — false
items.statement_en: Rain is composed mostly of salt water.

items.name: Rain — improbable
items.statement_en: Rain fell on this town every single day for two full years.

items.name: Rain — anomalous
items.statement_en: The rain divided its gray ideas among the impatient umbrellas.

items.name: Rain — impossible
items.statement_en: More rain fell this morning than fell during the whole day that contains this morning.

items.name: Apples — false

items.name: Apples — anomalous

items.name: Apples — impossible
items.statement_en: The basket holds more apples than it holds pieces of fruit.

items.name: Bachelor — true

items.name: Bachelor — false

items.name: Bachelor — improbable

items.name: Bachelor — anomalous

items.name: Bachelor — impossible

items.name: Grandmother — anomalous
